title: `knip --production` reports real
result: presets mark runtime entries and sources with `!`, exclude tests, mocks and stories in production only, and ignore `astro`/`nuxt` in production only; `existingEntries` strips the mark; root config marks package and template sources. Root production run went from 22 dependency reports to 3, all `@tailwindcss/vite` (a build plugin declared in `dependencies`, a true finding left for the templates to decide); default run output identical.
evidence: f412b33; `tests/knip.production.test.ts` runs real knip; 8 templates exit 0 in default mode.
